subject: maths
question:
The following bar graph shows the marks obtained by 5 students of a class.

What is the difference between the highest and the lowest marks?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/765c5006ca3410c9b46a597f5784ed691e1af99997d258bfda4a17687f82b688.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Highest marks obtained by the students in the class = 60

Lowest marks obtained by the students in the class = 35

Difference = 60 - 35 = 25

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
